the response status should be 200

description:
As a Super Admin
  I want to provision a new tenant from the platform console
  So that a client can start using the platform

  The Super Admin is never a member of the client's tenant (Product Spec R-ACT-02), so the tenant is
  created without an Owner and the client's Owner joins through an OWNER invitation.

elements.name: A Super Admin creates a tenant and invites its Owner

steps.name: the application is running
I am signed in as a Super Admin
I create the tenant "Acme Provisioned" for the owner "owner-prov@acme.com"
the response status should be 201
the response holds an active tenant "Acme Provisioned" whose verification is "unverified"
the response holds a pending "owner" invitation for "owner-prov@acme.com"
the response carries neither the widget token secret nor the invitation token hash
the new tenant has no members yet
the new tenant has exactly one pending "owner" invitation for "owner-prov@acme.com"
"tenant.created" is queued in the outbox for the new tenant
the creation of the new tenant is audit-logged with the Super Admin as actor

elements.name: The invited Owner accepts and becomes the tenant's Owner

steps.name: the application is running
I am signed in as a Super Admin
I create the tenant "Acme Joined" for the owner "owner-join@acme.com"
the Owner's invitation link carries the token "bdd-prov-invite-token"
"owner-join@acme.com" is signed in with the Ory identity "kratos-prov-owner"
I send a POST request to "/api/v1/invitations/public/bdd-prov-invite-token/accept" with that token
the response status should be 200
"owner-join@acme.com" is the "owner" of the new tenant

description:
As an Owner
  I want to stop a member's access without removing them
  So that I can give it back later, with the same role, and the trail shows both

elements.name: Disabling keeps the member, revokes their Keto membership and is audited

steps.name: the application is running
a company has signed itself up for billing
I am that billing company's Owner
that company has an "operator" member
I "disable" that member
the response status should be 200
that member answers with status "disabled" and a disabled date
that member's row is kept, disabled and not deleted
a Keto "remove_member" effect is queued for that member
"user.disabled" is on the audit trail for that member

elements.name: Enabling restores the member's role in Keto and is audited

steps.name: the application is running
a company has signed itself up for billing
I am that billing company's Owner
that company has an "operator" member
I "disable" that member
I "enable" that member
the response status should be 200
that member answers with status "active" and no disabled date
a Keto "assign_role" effect is queued for that member
"user.enabled" is on the audit trail for that member

elements.name: Disabling twice answers the same disabled member

steps.name: the application is running

I am that billing company's Owner
that company has an "operator" member
I "disable" that member
I "disable" that member
the response status should be 200
that member answers with status "disabled" and a disabled date

description:
As an Owner
  I want to read the secret my backend signs the widget user JWT with, and replace it if it leaks
  So that only my backend can vouch for who is looking at the referral widget

elements.name: The Owner reads the secret, and the read is audited

steps.name: the application is running
a company has signed itself up
I am that company's Owner
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/tenants/widget-secret" with that token
the response status should be 200
the response holds a 64-character hex secret
it is the secret Event Ingestion receives
the database does not hold it in plain text
the read is audit-logged with the Owner as actor

elements.name: Rotation replaces the secret, and the old one keeps working for an hour

steps.name: the application is running
a company has signed itself up
I am that company's Owner
I have read the current secret
I send a POST request to "/api/v1/tenants/widget-secret/rotate" with that token
the response status should be 200
the response holds a 64-character hex secret
it differs from the secret before the rotation
Event Ingestion receives the new secret and the previous one until about an hour from now
"tenant.widget_secret_rotated" is queued for that company without the secret

name: The Owner reads and rotates the widget-token secret (US1.5.4)
